title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging improvements
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers operating in regulated environments require deterministic KMS residency and end-to-end audit trails when RBAC v2 policies are applied. This PR implements enforcement for KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time, improves audit logging for KMS-related policy decisions, and hardens the admin flows for creating region-constrained keys. Summary of changes: 1) Policy evaluation: RBAC v2 evaluator now checks a new kms_residency constraint on role bindings and resource policies. If a request attempts to use a KMS key outside the allowed region(s) configured on the role, the request is rejected with a clear audit event. 2) Audit logging: Added structured audit entries for KMS key selection, region decision path, and policy fallback events. Audit entries include: principal, role, requested_key_id, requested_key_region, allowed_regions, decision (allow/deny), and decision_reason. 3) KMS validation: On KMS key registration and on deployment-time key imports we validate region metadata and surface warnings/errors in the console and CLI. 4) Migration: Small data migration to attach kms_residency metadata to existing role bindings (best-effort automated, with a follow-up manual remediation guide). 5) Tests & E2E: Added unit tests for policy evaluation, integration end-to-end with the KMS emulator, and a canary in staging. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind "rbac_v2_kms_residency" and opt-in per-organization. Start with audit mode (log-only) for 2 weeks, then enforce for orgs that opt-in or meet compliance requirements. Checklist: - [x] Policy evaluator changes implemented - [x] Audit events defined and emitted - [x] CLI/console validations added - [x] Migration script + remediation doc included - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan - [x] Security review and threat modeling note attached (SEC-210) Related: ENG-4321 (policy evaluator refactor), SUP-1284 (customer support case for KMS keys deployed in wrong region).

Maya Chen: Added a simple in-memory cache with TTL and watched events for invalidation. Cache code is small and guarded behind feature flag for initial rollout.
